name: Proton Pass
summary: Proton Pass for business has an Essentials plan at $1.99 per user a month for teams of 3 to 30 people and a Professional plan at $4.99, both on yearly billing. Single sign-on, SCIM, activity logs and SIEM export come with Professional.

facts.text: The Proton Pass client apps are open source and published on GitHub.
Items are encrypted on the device with 256-bit AES-GCM, and Proton stores data on servers in Germany, Switzerland and Norway.
Recurity Labs audited the Proton Pass apps, browser extensions and command-line tool between January and April 2026 and reported no remote exploits or encryption bypasses.
Proton holds a SOC 2 Type II attestation from Schellman, dated July 2025, and ISO 27001 certification.
Proton says any customer can request a HIPAA business associate agreement by email; the page does not say whether it covers Proton Pass.

plans.name: Pass Essentials
plans.notes: Shown as $1.99 a month with a 60% discount label. $4.99 on monthly billing. 3 to 30 users.

plans.name: Pass Professional
plans.notes: Shown as $4.99 a month with a 29% discount label. $6.99 on monthly billing. Minimum 3 users.

hiddenCosts: Yearly prices carry discount labels, and the page does not say whether renewals cost more.
Single sign-on, SCIM, activity logs, enterprise policies and SIEM export are not part of Pass Essentials.
Every plan needs at least 3 users.

contract.cancellation: Renews for the same length unless cancelled before the renewal date; a full refund is available within 30 days of the first purchase.
contract.dataExport: PGP-encrypted JSON in a ZIP, an unencrypted ZIP or CSV, from the browser extension, web app or Windows app; the mobile apps cannot export.
